definitions.explanation: Characterized by intensity, force, or lack of gentleness.
Lacking politeness or gentleness in behavior or speech.
Describing excessive use of money, food, etc.

notes:
{荒|あら}い is an i-adjective describing roughness, wildness, or intensity.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {荒|あら}く
- Noun form: {荒|あら}さ (roughness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い (rough waves)
- ⟦{気性|きしょう}→気性：10450_kishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い (violent temper)
- ⟦{金遣|かねづか}い→金遣い：10449_kanezukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い (spendthrift)
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い (breathing heavily)
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い (harsh words)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荒|あら}い vs. ⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧: Both read あらい, but {荒|あら}い refers to intensity/behavior (rough, wild), while ⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧ refers to texture/quality (coarse, crude).

Register: Neutral. Can describe natural phenomena, personality, or behavior.
